Interested in replacing current post-call QA pipeline (manual summaries + spreadsheet-based coaching) with automated transcripts + TL;DRs + coaching highlights. Technical requirements / notes:

- Latency SLO: post-call summary generation <5s median for stored audio; real-time partial summaries acceptable for live coaching.
- Throughput: baseline 5k calls/day, peaks 25k calls/day during promotional periods.
- Accuracy: speaker diarization + role tagging (agent/customer), actionable highlight precision >85% on coaching labels.
- Integrations: Zendesk, Salesforce, internal data lake (S3), ability to create tickets via tool-calls.
- Model preferences: open-weights preferred for cost control; quantized LLMs acceptable. Want fallback to smaller model variant during spikes.
- Data controls: audio must be redacted for PCI fields before storage; retention configurable per region.
- Observability: per-call latency breakdown, token cost estimates, retrain/feedback loop for QA labels.
